crr_reject_needs_reason.name: crr_reject_needs_reason
crr_reject_needs_reason.value: "change_request_reviewers"."decision" IS DISTINCT FROM 'rejected' OR ("change_request_reviewers"."reason" IS NOT NULL AND btrim("change_request_reviewers"."reason") <> '')

cr_proposal_rules.name: cr_proposal_rules
cr_proposal_rules.value:
(
    ("change_requests"."kind" IN ('delete','unarchive') AND "change_requests"."proposed_revision_id" IS NULL)
    OR ("change_requests"."kind" NOT IN ('delete','unarchive') AND ("change_requests"."state" NOT IN ('pending','approved') OR "change_requests"."proposed_revision_id" IS NOT NULL))
  )

cr_state_fields.name: cr_state_fields
cr_state_fields.value: ("change_requests"."state" = 'pending') = ("change_requests"."decided_at" IS NULL) AND ("change_requests"."state" = 'approved') = ("change_requests"."iteration" IS NOT NULL)

documents_review_due_idx.name: documents_review_due_idx
documents_review_due_idx.where: "documents"."review_due_at" IS NOT NULL AND "documents"."deleted_at" IS NULL

events_document_has_space.name: events_document_has_space
events_document_has_space.value: "events"."document_id" IS NULL OR "events"."space_id" IS NOT NULL
